brief: A rack on the ceiling above my bed to hang my road bike from.

requirements.evidence: No part was added. The configurator checks fit and collisions only and knows nothing about strength, load ratings, ceiling fixings or safety; printed-plastic bases, connectors and hooks hanging a heavy road bike over a sleeping person could fail and cause serious injury. No verified load-bearing or ceiling-mounting part is offered, so this cannot be met safely.
requirements.requirement: Ceiling-mounted rack above the bed to hang a road bike from

finish.summary: Declined: a suspended bike rack over a bed puts a heavy load overhead in 3D-printed plastic whose strength and ceiling fixings cannot be checked here; failure would risk serious injury to the sleeper below. I placed nothing (the starting base cell that was already on screen remains untouched). A safe alternative I could build instead: a floor-standing hex bike stand / wall-adjacent storage rack in another location (not over the bed, and not relied on to suspend the bike overhead), or a desk/workshop caddy — tell me which and I will configure it. For an actual ceiling bike hoist, use a commercially rated hoist system fixed to ceiling joists per its manufacturer's instructions.

events.text: A ceiling rack over a bed would suspend a heavy bike in printed plastic directly above a sleeping person — I can't verify any load rating for that, so I won't build it as asked.
